extraction_method: water/tee-marker landmarks extracted via programmatic color segmentation (connected components on blue/red/orange/blue pixel masks); fairway-stripe and green landmarks extracted via manual pixel reading on zoomed crops. No landmark invented for geometry not visibly present in both images (e.g. no bunker landmark -- East Hole 8's official tip text describes only OB both sides + pond, no bunker, and none is visible in either image).

landmarks.description: tee area (KLPGA single tee pad vs BH centroid of red/orange/blue tee markers -- structural mismatch, lower confidence)
primary water hazard centroid (KLPGA single blob matched to BH's near/green-side lobe specifically, not the combined 2-lobe shape -- see note)

transform_selection_reason: Homography (8 DOF) achieved the lowest training residual (median 3.2px) but catastrophically overfit on leave-one-out testing (max LOO residual 203.7px on only 6 points). Affine (6 DOF) also overfit relative to its training fit (train median 4.6px vs LOO median 10.6px, LOO max 27.9px). Similarity (4 DOF: uniform scale + rotation + translation) had the best-generalizing leave-one-out residual (median 7.4px, max 12.6px) despite a slightly higher training residual (median 4.9px) -- the correct model given only 6 landmarks. The fitted rotation is -89.88 degrees (~90 degrees), i.e. the two illustrations are the same hole rotated ~90 degrees with uniform scale, not needing a higher-DOF model.
